items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: someone had “A Love Supreme,” John Coltrane and I heard that and I thought well that sounds like freedom to me

ctx.x: A couple of things to wrap up with. I know it’s hard to pinpoint one thing ever, you know one thing. But is there one recording that you can point to that you heard perhaps in your teen years that just like opened your ears up and provided some inspiration to you?

Yes. I can very much pinpoint the album, because funnily enough I was not into jazz at all. I don’t think I ever heard any jazz as a teenager, or if I did I would have thought what is all this nonsense. You know I was listening to pretty much ‘80s pop music and ‘90s pop music. And I was into – maybe I won’t say that, it’s slightly embarrassing. But yes, some low profile popular music let’s say all through my teenage years.
